summary_md: **David Garcia ([@iamdagy](https://x.com/iamdagy/status/2116118917773169036))** built **Redo** to fix shots without reshooting: reframe, one-click object removal, pause cutting, upscaling and background removal using open-weight models with native ComfyUI nodes ([redoapp.dev](https://redoapp.dev), [iamdagy/redo](https://github.com/iamdagy/redo)).
